## Past Achievements

### I-ADOPT related Publications
- 2021: Magagna, B., Rosati, I., Stoica, M., Schindler, S., Moncoiffe, G., Devaraju, A., Peters, J., & Huber, R. (2021). The i-adopt interoperability framework for fairer data descriptions of biodiversity. Proceedings of the 3rd International Workshop on Semantics for Biodiversity (S4BioDiv 2021), 2969. https://ceur- ws.org/Vol- 2969 65/paper10-s4biodiv.pdf
- 2022: RDA Endorsement of the I-ADOPT Recommendations ([DOI: 10.15497/RDA00071](https://zenodo.org/records/6520132#.YnOhMJNBybQ))

### Specifications
- June 2021: First public release of the [I-ADOPT ontology 0.0.8](https://i-adopt.github.io/ontology/archive/0.8.0/index.html)
- July 2023: Improved version [I-ADOPT ontology 1.0.1](https://i-adopt.github.io/ontology/archive/1.0.1/index.html)
- May 2025: Major revision [I-ADOPT ontology 1.1.0](https://i-adopt.github.io/ontology/archive/1.1.0/index.html)
- 2026: [I-ADOPT SHACL Shape](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SirkoS/iadopt-schema/main/shacl/iadopt.sh.ttl) definitions
- 2026: [Variable Design Patterns](https://github.com/mabablue/I-ADOPT-patterns-playground) and Decision Trees
- 2026: [I-ADOPT Guideline](https://github.com/mabablue/I-ADOPT-patterns-playground/blob/main/Guide/guideline.md)
- 2026: [I-ADOPT Corpus](https://i-adopt.github.io/Corpus/)

### I-ADOPT Services:
- 2025: A [Visualizer](https://sirkos.github.io/iadopt-vis/) enabling interactive modelling and visualizing of an I-ADOPT variable 
- 2025: [I-ADOPT Catalogue](https://github.com/SirkoS/iadopt-catalogue)
- 2026: A [Service for Variable Descriptions](https://github.com/ArvinRastegar/iadopt-variable-description-service) for local installation

## Ongoing Activities

- From Scientific Variables to Knowledge Graphs: The I-ADOPT Benchmark, Semantic Web Journal: Baseline paper for LLM experiments; Authors: Magagna, B., Rastegar, A., González Guardia, E., Berrio, C., Chalk, S., Schindler, S., Gómez-Pérez, J. M., Lorenz, C., Kumar, S., Garijo, D.

### Specifications
- Identifying constraint types for potential full FAIR representation
- Reviewing decision trees and patterns

## Future Developments
- Unpacking Constraints by modelling them as observations
- Resolving concepts used more than one time in different description components using paths
